head.t: Patient experience and engagement during acute non-invasive ventilation
head.x: Aim: To explore patients’ experiences of acute non-invasive ventilation (NIV) and examine the role of patient engagement in treatment acceptance and tolerance. Methods: A descriptive qualitative design was employed using semistructured interviews with five patients who had recently received acute NIV.

head.t: One in three internationally educated nurses ‘never been promoted’ in UK
head.x: More than a third (34%) of internationally educated nurses and midwives have never been promoted, including one in five (21%) of those with at least 10 years’ experience in the UK, a survey has revealed.

head.t: SNOMED CT UK Drug Extension: grouper concepts being removed, supplier survey closes 20 November 2026
head.x: NHS England is removing the five grouper concepts from the SNOMED CT UK Drug Extension in Phase 2 of its alignment to the SNOMED International national drug extension model, scheduled for Quarter 4 2026, and replacing them with Refsets.

head.t: Ombudsman report: Strengthening NHS wheelchair services
head.x: The Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman reports a significant rise in complaints about NHS wheelchair services over five years and sets out commissioning recommendations.

f.t: Five AI tools approved for identifying prostate cancer on MRI scans
f.x: Five artificial intelligence tools for more accurately detecting prostate cancer in MRI scans have been approved for use on the NHS. NICE said the tools have the potential to act like a ‘second pair of eyes’, helping radiologists review prostate MRI scans and improve accuracy and consistency of diagnosis.
